integrity: The original source result for the undeleted K_n,n is credited. The new crown-graph theorem is proved separately. Reproducibility code uses the original graph definition.
scientific_limitations: Proved for crown graphs n>=6; n=4,5 and complete optimum-coloring census are not determined. Computational tests are not the infinite proof. Published-priority coverage is qualified by indexing.
title: Optimal edge-locating colorings of crown graphs from two-hole Latin rectangles
